nodes.name: Postgres: Load Current Observations
nodes.notes: This is a deterministic render step. Frozen/approved observations are rendered as-is, never re-generated (FR-20).

nodes.name: Assign Stable Paragraph IDs (for round-trip mapping)
nodes.notes: Each rendered observation paragraph gets a bookmark/content-control tagged with its observation.id, so a later re-uploaded Word file can be diffed back to specific rows (feeds the Round-trip Reconciliation sub-workflow).

nodes.name: Render Word Document from Beyon Template
nodes.notes: Template fidelity enforced structurally (GR-02): structure/table shapes/rating colours validated against the fixed template before reaching the reviewer, not left to model judgement.
